name: Welcome
desc: A wider entry and a five-pixel chamber at 16 px. The cut keeps its 45-degree invitation while admitting more light.

name: Softneck
desc: The diagonal cut relaxes into a curved liquid neck. The doorway feels pulled open while the outer silhouette stays familiar.

name: Peek
desc: A broad resident peeks from the left doorjamb into an enlarged room. It is fused to the mark, with no separate eye or tiny floating detail.

name: Roundhouse
desc: A fuller bowl, rounded shoulder and softened inner corners make the same open doorway feel less formal and more approachable.

name: Swing
desc: A broad sloping inner plane suggests a door swung outward. The open door is built into the silhouette, rather than added as a thin leaf.

name: Bold
desc: The outer mass grows to a 56-unit footprint while the room keeps its four-pixel width at 16 px. More ink gives the favicon a stronger presence.
